args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1 (and v2.3.1-rc in staging) were marked unhealthy. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release marked healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again.

- **Cause:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also marked unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, the health check passes and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened INC-0001 (SEV2) for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the result, and says the cause of the v2.3.1 problem needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
